Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady handheld drift backward, holding @Image2 centered medium-wide as she steps deeper into the shallow wash. White foam rushes over her bare feet and ankles; @Image2 laughs out loud and takes two more steps forward into the cool water, arms relaxed at her sides, hair lifting in the breeze. Gentle waves lap and recede around her legs while light sparkles dance on the wet sand and grit

gentle ocean waves rolling onto Bondi Beach shoreline, soft breeze, distant surf. water splashing around bare feet, laughter, foam rushing over ankles.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
